subject: design-technology

moments.title: Patagonia founded
moments.body: Chouinard turns climbing-gear company into an outdoor clothing brand with environmental advocacy at its core.
moments.takeaway: Brand purpose can predate sustainability marketing.

moments.title: Cradle to Cradle published
moments.body: Their book argues for products designed so materials cycle continuously without becoming waste.
moments.takeaway: Design philosophy reframed waste as failure of design.

moments.title: Ellen MacArthur Foundation
moments.body: The foundation popularises 'circular economy' as a business and policy framework after MacArthur's round-the-world sail.
moments.takeaway: A sailor's experience of finite resources became a design framework.

now.title: Circular design today
now.body: EU and UK policy increasingly require circular design. Companies experiment with rental, refill and repair models.
now.open_questions: Can the global consumer economy actually circle?

reflection: The hardest design problem is to design for not-being-thrown-away.
